input.quote: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets our preferred position: a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, a mutual consequential-damages exclusion (with data restoration and replacement services preserved as direct damages), Excluded Claims covering confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and confirmation that our payment obligation is not "damages". Section 18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liability, so the cap is not undercut in our disfavour.

input.quote: Customer may terminate an Order Form immediately if Vendor suffers a material Security Incident, repeatedly misses a critical service level, violates Applicable Law in performing the Services, or infringes a third party's intellectual property and cannot provide the remedies required by Section 20.5.
input.rationale: There is no indemnification section anywhere in the agreement (numbering jumps from 19 to 21), yet Sections 9.3, 19.4, 21.3 and 30.5 all assume one, including a dangling cross-reference to "Section 20.5". With no Vendor IP indemnity at all this is walk-away territory, so we have inserted our standard Vendor indemnity with notice/control procedure, infringement remedies and a narrow Customer indemnity.
